newsitem.title: USA: Concepts Direct offers 1.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Concepts Direct offers 1.5 mln shares.

text.p: Concepts Direct Inc said on Wednesday that it commenced an offering of 1.5 million shares of its common stock at $16 each.
Of the 1.5 million shares offered, 471,404 shares are being sold by the company and 1,028,596 are being sold by certain stockholders.
Net proceeds to the company will be used for general corporate purposes, including additions to working capital, the direct marketer said in a statement.
EVEREN Securities Inc. is lead underwriter on the offering, with Scott & Stringfellow Inc as co-manager.
The names of the selling shareholders were not immediately available.
A Concepts Direct spokesman said about 744,000 of the shares were being sold by R.L. Polk & Co., a private company that had owned an interest in Concepts Direct's predecessor.
Executives in the company had sold about 220,000 shares, but that represents about 12 percent interest of their positions before the offering, a spokesman said.
